title: afar1/fieldtheory-cli
claim: afar1/fieldtheory-cli — Field Theory CLI for bookmarks, Library, commands, and agent workflows
why_good: A personal CLI unifying bookmarks, a command library and agent workflows — handy, but broad and reads like one dev's toolkit.
value: Unclear buyer; a pro/sync tier is possible but the scope is too diffuse to charge for yet.
risk: Diffuse scope, no clear wedge; more a personal productivity script than a company.
pick_reason: The project offers a clear product for efficient bookmark management and workflow automation that can be monetized.
